A.title: Evidence Core (provider registry, model, qualification, coverage builder)

B.title: Evidence Surface Guard (guard-types, guard-policy, guard, retrieval/clarify/defer/block control)

C.title: Evidence Security Oracle (188 adversarial vectors, 20-surface bypass audit, threat model, fixtures)

production_facade.request_schema: strict Zod object; unknown keys rejected; no requirements/coverage/initial_coverage/provider/now/checked_at/evidence_ids fields exist

trusted_boundaries.capability_lookup: constructor-injected trusted catalog; EVIDENCE_CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND / EVIDENCE_CAPABILITY_VERSION_MISMATCH fail closed
trusted_boundaries.clock: constructor-injected; request can never set time
trusted_boundaries.stores: server-owned QualifiedEvidenceStore and GuardRunStore (bounded, in-memory V1)

production_facade.pipeline: trusted requirements -> subject binding -> provider collection -> Lane A qualification -> coverage builder -> Lane B Guard (proceed/retrieve_more/clarify/defer/block) -> server-owned GuardRunRecord

checks: guard run exists in server-owned store
current requirements digest == run requirements digest
every evidence_id/conflict id traces to a qualified record
eligibility.authority: only source of executable-plan evidence coverage; no snapshot may be passed in by the caller

digests.requirements: canonical JSON + SHA-256 over exact required_evidence
digests.coverage: canonical JSON + SHA-256 over final coverage snapshot
digests.claim: canonical JSON (sorted keys, array order preserved) + SHA-256; NaN/Infinity/undefined/BigInt/class instances/cycles rejected

evidence_id.encoding: length-prefixed UTF-8 tuple (32-bit big-endian byte length + bytes per field: provider_id, evidence_class, subject_key, source_item_id, claim_digest) hashed with SHA-256
evidence_id.controls: NUL and control characters rejected in every identity component

stores.qualified_evidence_store: bounded in-memory ledger (default 2000); duplicate id + identical content idempotent (qualified_at is processing metadata, excluded from content equality); duplicate id + different content = EVIDENCE_LINEAGE_CONFLICT; tombstoned ids can never re-enter; overflow = EVIDENCE_COLLECTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
stores.guard_run_store: bounded in-memory FIFO store (default 100); guard_run_id core-generated via crypto.randomUUID()
stores.restart_semantics: V1 in-memory only: after Brain Server restart all guard runs are invalidated and eligibility fails closed; evidence must be recollected. No persistent evidence authorization is claimed.

forged_coverage_closure: caller cannot pass requirements (EVIDENCE_INPUT_INVALID, unknown key)
caller cannot pass initial coverage / coverage snapshot
caller cannot select providers or register providers through any public surface
caller cannot set now / checked_at / observed time
forged snapshots fail eligibility without server-owned guard run + traceable qualified lineage

adversarial_oracle.map_integrity: counts vs vector source, per-vector test-name binding, zero unmapped/manual/failed

limitations_v1: GuardRunStore/QualifiedEvidenceStore are in-memory and do not survive Brain Server restart
No live GitHub evidence provider; github evidence class catalog is roadmap only (cp6-github-evidence-class-catalog.json)
EvidenceEligibilityService returns authoritative coverage + lineage; it does not set plan state or execute anything
Lower-level pure APIs (buildEvidenceCoverage, runEvidenceGuard, assessEvidenceCoverage) remain internal composable primitives and are not execution authority
